## Entry points

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`scripts/Find-BrainKnowledge.ps1`](../scripts/Find-BrainKnowledge.ps1) | Asks the second brain: search its knowledge and the connected repos, resolve an inventory app name, or show the sizing calibration. |
| [`scripts/Get-VaultHarvest.ps1`](../scripts/Get-VaultHarvest.ps1) | Proposes what a customer vault may contribute to the knowledge base: generalized estate facts, recurring findings, and runbook and lesson candidates. |
| [`scripts/Import-CurrentStateFacts.ps1`](../scripts/Import-CurrentStateFacts.ps1) | Checks a redacted current-state snapshot (contract C11, avd-current-state-facts/v1) and files it in the estate vault's facts store. |
| [`scripts/Import-SizingEvidence.ps1`](../scripts/Import-SizingEvidence.ps1) | Turns measured host pool utilization (contract avd-sizing-evidence/v1) into sizing calibration observations. |
| [`scripts/Sync-BrainSources.ps1`](../scripts/Sync-BrainSources.ps1) | Checks out the connected repositories (sources/sources.json) so the brain can search their lessons and decisions. |
| [`scripts/Test-DocConsistency.ps1`](../scripts/Test-DocConsistency.ps1) | Checks that a repo's docs agree with its code and with the brain's facts of record (docs consistency, D1 to D11). |
| [`scripts/Test-KbLeaks.ps1`](../scripts/Test-KbLeaks.ps1) | Runs the brain's sensitive-text guard over the family knowledge base (docs/knowledge/) and llms.txt. |
| [`scripts/Test-Knowledge.ps1`](../scripts/Test-Knowledge.ps1) | Checks the organizational second brain's knowledge base (knowledge/): schemas, scope, cross-references and customer data. |
| [`scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1`](../scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1) | Regenerates the docs that come from the code: reference pages, README blocks, the changelog and the handbook. |
| [`vault/avd_second_brain.ps1`](../vault/avd_second_brain.ps1) | AVD Second Brain -- turns collector and validator evidence packages into a living, Markdown knowledge base for an Azure Virtual Desktop estate. |
